crossRefs.note: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

translations.web: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
translations.bsb: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.
translations.kjv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
translations.asv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
